label: R-act2 from dependence through the first unde and inclusion, checked (inference)
rule: Witness the pure perfection, actualize it through esse, include it in esse
meaning: For a pure perfection d, some x has d in act; by R-dep x has being; by the first unde d is actual in x through esse; by inclusion d is a perfection of esse itself. Given the first three premises, inclusion is equivalent to the conclusion (undeLoadMap).
